rule: S2 observes with the robot's head camera only (owner, 2026-11-24 16:15)

pictures.caption: What S2 is given at the start of t41 (power strip) under the head-camera rule: the head camera's colour image (848 x 480, on the robot's stand, looking forward and down) inside a labelled pixel grid, with the nine objects the session located in that observation's depth outlined and numbered. The numbers are the ones S2 uses (numbered[2] is the power strip with its cord). The red switch pad is not an object of its own: S2 reads its pixel off the grid (about u 570, v 320) and asks point_at(view, u, v). Scripted proof session, no LLM; verdict FAIL as expected (nothing was pressed).

What S2 is given on t19 (jar and drawer) after one reach planned from the head camera's depth alone (palm 18 cm above the largest located object): the same camera, now with the robot's right arm and hand in the picture. The hand covers what is under it; this is the only view S2 has, so it must move the hand away (clear_view) to see the result of its work. Scripted proof session, no LLM; verdict FAIL as expected (nothing was moved).
